title: Swade et al. (2024) — 논문 원본 매크로팩터+BL 정의로 한국시장 복제

design.paper: Swade et al. (2024) A Century of Macro Factor Investing, Robeco/JPM
design.IMPORTANT: 논문 원본 매크로팩터 분류 + RP + BL 그대로.

paper_methodology.step1: 3 macro group의 long-short 팩터 수익률 구축
paper_methodology.step2: Base allocation: Risk Parity (equal risk contribution across 3 groups). expanding covariance.
paper_methodology.step3: BL overlay views: (a) 매크로 view = v7.1 MRS 기반 (crisis→Defensive overweight, risk_on→Growth overweight), (b) 팩터모멘텀 view = trailing 12m 팩터 수익률
paper_methodology.step4: BL posterior → constrained MVO (min 15%, max 50% per group)
paper_methodology.step5: Group 내 종목 선정: 해당 group 팩터 composite score Top N → 전체 Top 30
